package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDiscoveryOracle(t *testing.T) {
	a := batch(1, "worker", "one", 1, 0, 10_000_000_000, 11_000_000_000)
	b := batch(2, "frontend", "two", 1, 0, 20_000_000_000, 21_000_000_000)
	a.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("request.kind", "api"), {Key: "retries", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: -9223372036854775808}}}, {Key: "cached", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: false}}}, {Key: "mixed", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: false}}}, value("same", "false"), value("unicode", "café"), value("empty", ""), {Key: "opaque", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BytesValue{BytesValue: []byte("abc")}}}}
	b.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("request.kind", "rpc"), {Key: "retries", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: 9223372036854775807}}}, {Key: "cached", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: true}}}, value("mixed", "false"), value("same", "true"), value("empty", "")}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, a, b)
	var rows []*Trace
	for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		tr := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	ctx := context.Background()
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	type Case struct {
		Mode     string      `json:"mode"`
		Scope    string      `json:"scope"`
		Key      string      `json:"key"`
		Response interface{} `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _, scope := range []string{"resource", "span"} {
		set := map[string]bool{}
		err := block.SearchTags(ctx, traceql.AttributeScopeFromString(scope), func(k string, _ traceql.AttributeScope) { set[k] = true }, func(uint64) {}, opts)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		keys := []string{}
		for k := range set {
			keys = append(keys, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(keys)
		cases = append(cases, Case{"names", scope, "", map[string]interface{}{"scopes": []interface{}{map[string]interface{}{"name": scope, "tags": keys}}}})
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"resource.service.name", "resource.absent", "span.request.kind", "span.retries", "span.cached", "span.same", "span.mixed", "span.empty", "span.unicode"} {
		attr, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(name)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		set := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
		err = block.SearchTagValuesV2(ctx, attr, traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { set[v] = true; return false }), func(uint64) {}, opts)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		vals := []tempopb.TagValue{}
		for v := range set {
			vals = append(vals, v)
		}
		sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool {
			if vals[i].Type == vals[j].Type {
				return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value
			}
			return vals[i].Type < vals[j].Type
		})
		scope, key, _ := strings.Cut(name, ".")
		cases = append(cases, Case{"values", scope, key, map[string]interface{}{"tagValues": vals}})
	}
	// Optional one-off public protobuf consumer check, not a replay dependency.
	for _, c := range cases {
		wire, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-discovery/" + c.Scope + "-" + c.Key + ".protobuf")
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var got, want proto.Message
		if c.Mode == "names" {
			got = &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
			want = &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
		} else {
			got = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
			want = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
		}
		expected, _ := json.Marshal(c.Response)
		if err := json.Unmarshal(expected, want); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		actualJSON, _ := json.Marshal(got)
		expectedJSON, _ := json.Marshal(want)
		if string(actualJSON) != string(expectedJSON) {
			t.Fatalf("protobuf consumer mismatch %s.%s got %s want %s", c.Scope, c.Key, actualJSON, expectedJSON)
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-discovery/oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-discovery/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
